meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 它把你 claude-mem 里的观察记录按项目、类型、概念、文件等条件筛成语料库,再加载进一个 AI 会话;之后你就这段历史提问,它基于语料作答,追问保留上下文。
howto.when: 当你想从观察记录里建一个专门的「大脑」、询问过去的工作模式,或把某主题整理成知识库时使用。

howto.what_en: It filters your claude-mem observations by project, type, concept, file, or query into a corpus, loads that corpus into an AI session, and answers your questions from it, keeping context across follow-ups.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to build a focused "brain" from your observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a specific topic.
